title: GPM IMERG Final Run daily precipitation (GPM_3IMERGDF v07)
fetched: 9,039 daily files, 6 cells of 0.1 degree over the pilot area
resolution: 0.1 degree (~9 x 11 km here); daily accumulation from half-hourly estimates
credit: Huffman, G. J. et al. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC).
access: NASA cloud OPeNDAP (opendap.earthdata.nasa.gov), spatial subset per daily file, Earthdata bearer token; needs the GES DISC data-use agreement accepted on the account
message: 9,039 days; 0 daily files failed; sanity passed
notes: A satellite estimate calibrated to monthly gauge totals, not a rain gauge: it can miss or misplace small summer thunderstorms and struggles with snowfall over mountains. One cell covers many fields. The product's randomError field was not used: its scale in the daily files could not be interpreted reliably.
